title: Pan-Seared Hake with Korean-Style Bibimbap
description: A Korean-inspired dish featuring pan-seared hake with a crunchy bibimbap topping. Serve immediately for a delightful meal.

ingredients.name: Bibimbap mixture
ingredients.notes: Crisp Korean rice vinegar rice, yellowed bell peppers, korean chili flakes, and chopped green onions

instructions: 2. Season the hake fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Pan-sear the hake fillets in sesame oil until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Transfer the hake to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. In a large bowl, combine the bibimbap mixture, chopped green onions, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
6. To assemble the dish, place a cooked hake fillet on each plate and top with the bibimbap mixture.
7. Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
